Role description

About the Department

The Finance Operations department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long-term and short-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.
The Role &

Responsibilities The Executive Vice President - Order to Cash / Accounts Receivable will lead TresVista’s end-to-end revenue-to-cash agenda, with ownership across invoicing, collections, credit risk, revenue assurance, pricing insights, customer contract inputs, cash forecasting, and O2C transformation. This is a high-impact, customer-facing leadership role requiring strong commercial judgement, business acumen, analytical depth, and the ability to partner with stakeholders across Commercial, Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Product, and business leadership.

Beyond traditional AR accounting, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, statutory audit support, DSO calculation, and transaction governance, the role will be expected to create measurable business value by anticipating risks, solving structural issues, improving cash predictability, and using technology, dashboards, automation, AI/RPA, and analytics to build a scalable O2C operating model.

Key Role Deliverables:

• Commercial Finance, Revenue Insights & Pricing Governance

• Partner with business and commercial teams to evaluate pricing models, cost inflators, customer discounts, sales commissions, CAC, customer lifetime value, ARR, and revenue added by channel/product

• Provide analytical insights on churn, customer loyalty, customer profitability, customer behavior, and revenue leakage to support strategic decision-making

• Act as a core member of the pricing committee and provide inputs on price structuring, discount governance, customer viability, renewal economics, and commercial risk.

Customer Contracts, Churn Mitigation & Legal Partnership

• Participate in the customer contract committee and advise on payment terms, collection enforceability, contract risk, churn triggers, discounting terms, and revenue protection clauses

• Work closely with Legal to resolve overdue accounts, contract disputes, collection challenges, and escalations requiring formal recovery or negotiation

• Develop mitigation practices to reduce churn, improve customer stickiness, and strengthen contract hygiene across new and existing client relationships.

Collections, International Banking & Treasury Partnership

• Lead timely collections across geographies by addressing customer-side issues, banking delays, failed payment flows, international remittance challenges, and process bottlenecks

• Partner with Treasury for cash forecasting, liquidity visibility, collection predictability, auto-collection mechanisms, and banking process improvements

• Own DSO, CEI, ageing movement, overdue reduction, unapplied cash, and collection-risk reporting with clear governance and escalation rhythm

• Digital Transformation, AI/RPA & Control Tower

• Build a digital-first O2C operating model through dashboards, RPA workflows, AI-enabled anomaly detection, auto-matching, cash application automation, and revenue/cash forecasting models

• Create exception-based control towers for invoice accuracy, collections risk, pricing exceptions, contract-related disputes, write-offs, credit memos, and customer-level exposure

• Drive business cases and ROI for collections platforms, EIPP/portals, cash application ML/IDP, workflow automation, and analytics-led decision support

• O2C Operations, Revenue Accounting & Controls

• Own end-to-end AR/O2C operations including billing accuracy, client invoicing, collections, cash application, credit notes, write-off governance, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, and statutory audit support

• Strengthen controls around onboarding, KYC, credit limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, billing accuracy, tax/e-invoicing readiness, and revenue handoffs

• Establish process discipline across customer master data, payment terms, dispute SLAs, credit governance, closing activities, and audit evidence readiness

• M&A, New Service Lines & Geographic Expansion Support

• Support due diligence for M&A, acquire opportunities, new service lines, new geographies, and new end markets by evaluating customer contracts, revenue quality, receivables, collection risks, and integration readiness

• Standardize customer master data, collection policies, payment terms, and O2C controls where new entities, products, markets, or customer portfolios are integrated into TresVista’s operating model

• Stakeholder Management & Leadership Rhythm

• Partner across Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Commercial, Product, business teams, and leadership to identify risks early, solve cross-functional issues, and drive accountable outcomes

• Run weekly exception and ageing reviews, monthly CFO/commercial reviews, and leadership packs covering cash, risk, churn, customer health, and transformation progress

Decision Rights

• Recommend and approve O2C credit, collections, customer contract, and e-billing governance standards in partnership with relevant stakeholders

• Prioritize the O2C automation roadmap, exception dashboards, workflow releases, and transformation initiatives in collaboration with IT and business teams

• Drive escalation decisions for overdue accounts, customer exposure, policy exceptions, and credit risk mitigation actions

• Propose transformation investments, vendor/platform requirements, ROI cases, and operating model changes for revenue-to-cash scalability

Success Measures (KPIs)

• Reduction in DSO, overdue balances, delinquency movement, write-offs, and unresolved disputes

• Improvement in CEI, timely collections, cash forecast accuracy, and customer-level collection predictability

• First-pass invoice accuracy, billing cycle-time reduction, reduction in pricing/contract/tax-related rework, and faster audit evidence turnaround

• Improvement in ARR visibility, ARR added by channel/product, churn insights, discount governance, customer lifetime value understanding, and revenue leakage prevention

• Automation adoption, cash application auto-match percentage, anomaly detection effectiveness, dashboard adoption, and measurable transformation ROI

• Improved stakeholder satisfaction across commercial, legal, treasury, finance, product, and leadership teams

Prerequisites:

• Chartered Accountant with 8 to 14 years of experience across Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, revenue accounting, commercial finance, credit risk, collections, or transformation-led finance operations

• Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to connect invoicing, collections, pricing, contracts, customer behavior, churn, revenue forecasting, and cash forecasting

• Customer-facing mindset with strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics/D365, or equivalent finance platforms; exposure to Power BI/control towers, collection platforms, EIPP/portals, AI/RPA, cash application automation, or workflow tools will be preferred

• Strong understanding of international banking, collections, customer contracting, credit policy, revenue controls, SOX/ICFR, statutory audit support, and multi-entity/multi-jurisdiction operations

• High analytical orientation with advanced Excel/reporting capability and the ability to convert data into insights, actions, and business decisions

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate problems, design mitigation plans, solve cross-functional issues, and operate effectively in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

• Self-driven, detail-oriented, proactive, entrepreneurial, and willing to build scalable processes while continuing to learn and grow.

Ideal Candidate Profile

• CA with 8 to 14 years of experience, preferably in a high-growth services, consulting, SaaS, technology-enabled, or global managed-services environment.

• Proven leadership in O2C/AR, collections, revenue assurance, credit governance, customer contracts, pricing analytics, cash forecasting, and commercial finance advisory

• Experience working directly with customers and senior internal stakeholders to resolve collection, pricing, contract, and revenue-related issues

• Strong transformation orientation with exposure to dashboards, AI/RPA, anomaly detection, cash forecasting, revenue forecasting, auto-collection, and automation-led finance operating models

• Ability to think strategically and critically while remaining hands-on in execution, controls, governance, and stakeholder follow-through.

Compensation The compensation structure will be as per industry standards

Senior Analyst, Risk Management

Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management – Individual Contributor

Overview

The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.

Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk-based IT control environment.

Manager – Accounts & Finance

Job Location: Pune (Camp)

Industry: Real Estate / Construction / Promoter & Developer

Reporting to: Head – Finance / CFO

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced and technology-savvy Manager – Accounts & Finance to lead the Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A and Tax Compliance functions for a leading promoter, developer and construction group in Pune.

The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, smooth monthly closing, effective tax compliance, robust MIS and FP&A support, and efficient utilisation of the organisation’s ERP system. The position will also lead and mentor the accounting team and drive process discipline, automation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Reporting

Lead day-to-day accounting operations across the group and ensure accuracy, completeness and timely recording of financial transactions.

Drive the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close process.

Review general ledger, reconciliations, provisions, accruals, revenue, costs, receivables, payables and other accounting schedules.

Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for construction projects, development activities, land transactions, project costs and related-party transactions.

Prepare and review financial statements and management reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

MIS, FP&A & Business Support

Lead preparation of monthly MIS, project-wise profitability reports, budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections and variance analysis.

Provide meaningful financial insights to management on project performance, costs, margins, working capital and cash flows.

Develop and improve management dashboards and analytical reports to support business decision-making.

Work closely with project, commercial, procurement and business teams to ensure timely and accurate financial information.

Tax & Statutory Compliance

Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance, including GST, TDS, Income Tax and other applicable statutory requirements.

Ensure timely filing of returns, payments, reconciliations and responses to tax/statutory queries.

Coordinate with external tax advisors, auditors and consultants wherever required.

Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the business.

ERP & Process Management

Take ownership of the ERP system from a finance and accounting perspective and ensure smooth and effective utilisation by the accounting and business teams.

Work with ERP teams/consultants to configure processes, improve controls and develop MIS reports.

Should have the ability to understand business requirements and design/define ERP-based MIS and reporting solutions.

Experience with ERP platforms such as Highrise, SAP or equivalent will be an advantage.

Drive standardisation, automation, internal controls and continuous improvement of finance processes.

Audit & Compliance

Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.

Maintain appropriate documentation and supporting schedules for audit and management review.

Strengthen financial controls and ensure compliance with internal policies and procedures.

Team Leadership

Lead, guide and motivate the accounting team to deliver accurate, timely and reliable financial information.

Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and develop team capabilities.

Establish a process-oriented and accountability-driven culture within the finance function.

Required Skills & Competencies

In-depth knowledge of accounting, financial reporting and month-end/year-end close processes.

Strong understanding of the real estate, construction, promoter and developer business, including project accounting and project-wise financial analysis.

Strong knowledge of FP&A, MIS, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.

Good understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances relevant to the business.

Strong ERP knowledge with the ability to use technology for process improvement and MIS development.

Experience with Highrise, SAP or similar ERP systems will be preferred.

Technology-savvy and comfortable working with ERP, reporting tools, Excel and data-driven financial analysis.

Strong process orientation, attention to detail and analytical ability.

Excellent people-management, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a fast-paced business environment.

Qualification & Experience

Chartered Accountant (CA) with 5 years of post qualification experience or completion of CA article ship with 10 years of experience in leading the accounting/finance function.

Candidates with substantial experience in a real estate, construction, promoter or developer organization will be strongly preferred.

Proven experience in managing accounting teams and delivering monthly MIS, financial close, statutory compliance and management reporting.

Key Success Measures

Timely and accurate monthly financial close.

Quality and timeliness of MIS and management reporting.

Effective project-wise financial and cost reporting.

Timely statutory and tax compliance.

Smooth and effective ERP operations.

Strong financial controls and audit readiness.

Improved finance processes, automation and reporting.

Effective leadership and development of the accounting team.

Role Overview:

The Market Risk Engineering (RE) team is a core function within Market Risk Management, responsible for ensuring the accuracy, robustness, and integrity of market risk measurement, reporting, and control processes. The team supports key market risk frameworks including Value-at-Risk (VaR), Stressed VaR (SVaR), FRTB, SA-CCR, backtesting, and regulatory risk reporting, working closely with Market Risk Managers, Front Office, and Risk Technology teams.
The role combines market risk analysis with risk production oversight and change delivery responsibilities. The successful candidate will review and analyse daily risk metrics, investigate material changes in risk exposures, support regulatory and control processes, and contribute to strategic initiatives including new product implementation, model enhancements, and market risk infrastructure change. The position offers broad exposure to market risk methodologies, trading products, regulatory frameworks, and risk management practices across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities:

Risk Analytics and Production support

• Review and analyse first-level of daily market risk reports, highlighting material changes in exposures, exceptions, and unusual portfolio movements.
• Analyse and explain movements in VaR, SVaR, FRTB, sensitivities and other market risk measures.
• Investigate significant changes in risk exposures and partner with Market Risk Managers and stakeholders to understand key drivers and emerging risk themes.
• Review risk concentrations, key market events, and portfolio sensitivities to identify areas of elevated risk.
• Contribute to the production, validation, and enhancement of market risk measures, methodologies, controls, and regulatory reporting processes.
• Perform VaR and FRTB-related analysis, including backtesting reviews, exception investigations, and risk-factor coverage assessments.
• Assess the impact of market events, concentration risks, and changing market environments on portfolio risk profiles.
• Support implementation of new products, trading strategies, and business initiatives, ensuring appropriate risk measurement, reporting, controls, and governance are established.
• Work closely with Market Risk Managers, Front Office, Quantitative Analytics, and Risk Technology teams to support new product onboarding and risk methodology enhancements.
• Participate in reviews of market risk models, assumptions, methodologies, and framework enhancements.
• Support regulatory initiatives and strategic programs relating to FRTB, SA-CCR, model governance, and market risk infrastructure improvements.
• Define and execute test scenarios, perform UAT, validate results, and coordinate issue resolution for market risk system enhancements and change initiatives.
• Identify weaknesses in risk data, controls, calculations, or reporting processes and drive remediation efforts with relevant stakeholders.
• Prepare risk analysis and management information for senior risk stakeholders, governance forums, and regulatory reviews.
• Contribute to automation and analytical initiatives that enhance market risk reporting, transparency, and operational effectiveness.

Qualifications:

• 3-10 years of experience within Market Risk, Risk Analytics, Product Control, Quantitative Risk, or a related risk management function.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 university in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Strong understanding of market risk methodologies including VaR, SVaR, stress testing, sensitivities, backtesting, FRTB, and regulatory market risk frameworks.
• Knowledge of traded products across Fixed Income, Credit, FX, Equity, and Derivatives markets.
• Experience analysing market risk exposures, investigating risk movements, and interpreting risk metrics to support risk management decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate across Market Risk, Front Office, Quantitative Analytics, Technology, and Change teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to communicate complex risk concepts effectively

Technical Skills (All Levels):

• Advanced Excel; SQL and Python required.
• Familiarity with risk systems, data platforms, and control frameworks.
• CFA / FRM / CQF is an advantage.

Job Description: Accounts & Finance Manager (Chartered Accountant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Chartered Accountant to lead our Finance & Accounts function. The Accounts & Finance Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, treasury, statutory compliance, audits, and internal controls. The role requires strong analytical abilities, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to support business growth while ensuring compliance with all applicable financial and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge of Indian accounting standards, direct and indirect taxation, financial planning and analysis, ERP systems, and corporate governance. The candidate will work closely with senior management to drive financial efficiency, improve business performance, and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Manage the complete accounting function and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with applicable accounting standards.
- Ensure timely book closure and preparation of trial balance, profit & loss account, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.
- Review general ledger balances and perform account reconciliations.
- Monitor fixed assets, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure accounting.
- Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

- Ensure complete compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory regulations.
- Review and file GST returns, TDS returns, Income Tax returns, and other statutory filings within prescribed timelines.
- Handle tax assessments, departmental notices, and litigation support.
- Coordinate with tax consultants and legal advisors for compliance and advisory matters.
- Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the organization.
- Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and maintain proper documentation.

3. Audit & Internal Controls

- Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and cost audits.
- Coordinate with external auditors and ensure timely completion of audits.
- Implement recommendations arising from audit findings.
- Develop and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Conduct periodic financial risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures.

4. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

- Prepare annual operating budgets in consultation with department heads.
- Develop monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
- Analyze budget versus actual performance and provide variance analysis.
- Support strategic financial planning and long-term business forecasting.
- Recommend cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives.

5. Treasury & Cash Flow Management

- Monitor daily cash flow and liquidity requirements.
- Manage banking relationships and oversee fund management activities.
- Prepare cash flow forecasts and optimize working capital.
- Coordinate loan documentation, banking facilities, and financial instruments.
- Ensure efficient utilization of available funds.

6. MIS & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly MIS reports for senior management.
- Develop dashboards and KPI reports for business performance monitoring.
- Analyze profitability, margins, operating costs, and financial trends.
- Present financial insights to support strategic decision-making.
- Identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost reduction.

7. Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Monitor vendor payments and ensure timely settlement.
- Review customer receivables and coordinate collection activities.
- Ensure proper reconciliation of customer and vendor accounts.
- Improve receivable cycles and reduce outstanding balances.

8. ERP & Process Improvement

- Ensure effective utilization of ERP systems for finance operations.
- Participate in ERP implementation, upgrades, and process automation initiatives.
- Improve accounting processes through digitization and automation.
- Develop standardized financial procedures across business functions.

9. Team Management

- Lead, supervise, and mentor the finance and accounts team.
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and training sessions.
- Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

10. Business Support

- Provide financial support for new projects, investments, and expansion initiatives.
- Conduct financial feasibility studies and investment analysis.
- Support management during mergers, acquisitions, fundraising, or due diligence activities.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

- Chartered Accountant (CA) .

Job Title: Chartered Accountant- Bank Audit Associate

Location: Pune

Experience: 0-2 years
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)

Role Summary:

We are looking for a qualified CA with 0-2 years of experience in auditing Banks. The role involves executing end-to-end audit procedures, including testing of advances, investments, deposits, revenue recognition, and treasury operations, while ensuring compliance with RBI guidelines, Ind AS, and prudential norms.
Key Responsibilities

1. Planning & Risk Assessment

• Assist in developing audit plans, conducting risk assessments, and selecting advance/loan samples as per defined criteria.

• Evaluate internal controls and compliance with bank policies and regulatory requirements.

• Perform tests of controls to assess their effectiveness in mitigating risks.

• Coordinate with auditees for audit requirements and ensure timely follow-up.

2. Branch Audits

• Visit selected branches and conduct Credit Audit, Branch Operations Audit, and review of branch statements.

• Examine credit policies for adequacy, updates, and regulatory compliance.

• Verify selected loan files as per the audit checklist, including loan applications, approvals, collateral documentation, and customer financial information.

3. Head Office Department Audits

• Conduct audits of various Head Office departments as per the defined scope.

• Perform financial audits, including financial statement review and transaction testing.

4. Reporting

• Document audit findings, including non-compliance, control weaknesses, and potential risks.

• Discuss findings and recommendations with bank management and obtain feedback.

• Prepare comprehensive audit reports and submit them to the Manager and Partner for review.

5. Documentation

• Ensure all audit procedures, evidence, and conclusions are properly documented.

• Maintain clear, concise, accurate, and timely documentation that enables an experienced auditor to understand the work performed and conclusions reached.

• Use the firm's standardized templates and formats for consistency and ease of review.

• Ensure secure storage and restricted access to audit documentation.

• Archive audit records to protect them from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

Qualifications/Required Skill Set:

• CA with 0-2 years of relevant audit experience

• Proficient in MS Office; good documentation and communication skills

Experience:

• Should have done articleship from a audit CA firm having atleast 3-4 partners.

• Strong understanding of RBI regulations, Ind AS, and banking processes

• Prior experience in a CA firm or audit of financial institutions preferred
